title: Croatian Crispy Chicken Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful dish that combines the best of Croatian cuisine with a crispy twist. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
In a large skillet, cook the diced bacon over medium heat until crispy.
Add the sautéed onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the earthly mushroom to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the Croatian paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet mixture to a baking dish and top with the seasoned chicken breast.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
